subject: CFArrayRef<->NSArray*

observation.summary: Runtime probe creates an NSArray literal @[@1, @2, @3] and casts it as CFTypeRef; CFGetTypeID() returns 19, identical to CFArrayGetTypeID() (also 19). The CFArrayRef and NSArray* pointers are identical (identity-preserving toll-free bridge).
observation.raw_output_excerpt: NSArray  -> CFArray: ns=0x10076c150 cf=OK (id match? expected=19 got=19)

claim: On this host CFArrayRef is identity-preserved with NSArray* under __bridge cast and CFGetTypeID returns the same value as CFArrayGetTypeID (19), confirming the CFArray<->NSArray toll-free bridge.
